related.title: IBM Heron 超導量子處理器
related.why: 可遷移量子狀態、控制、量測及不確定度模型；實體編碼與硬體限制需重設。
related.whyEn: Quantum states, control, measurement and uncertainty transfer, while physical encodings/hardware constraints must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移量子狀態、控制、量測及不確定度模型；實體編碼與硬體限制需重設。
related.transferEn: Quantum states, control, measurement and uncertainty transfer, while physical encodings/hardware constraints must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對碼距、每循環邏輯錯誤與完整系統指標；IBM Heron 超導量子處理器改以可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on code distance, logical error per cycle and system metrics; IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor centers on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照Willow 非諧能階與transmon 能階，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到IBM Heron 超導量子處理器，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以跨碼距閾值比較為起點，設計一項能區分「碼距、每循環邏輯錯誤與完整系統指標」與「可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare willow anharmonic levels with transmon levels and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from cross-distance threshold comparison and propose an observation distinguishing code distance, logical error per cycle and system metrics from tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control, including uncertainty.

related.title: Quantinuum H2 QCCD 離子架構
related.why: 可遷移量子狀態、控制、量測及不確定度模型；實體編碼與硬體限制需重設。
related.whyEn: Quantum states, control, measurement and uncertainty transfer, while physical encodings/hardware constraints must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移量子狀態、控制、量測及不確定度模型；實體編碼與硬體限制需重設。
related.transferEn: Quantum states, control, measurement and uncertainty transfer, while physical encodings/hardware constraints must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對碼距、每循環邏輯錯誤與完整系統指標；Quantinuum H2 QCCD 離子架構改以跑道陷阱、分區搬運及中途量測為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on code distance, logical error per cycle and system metrics; Quantinuum H2 QCCD ion architecture centers on racetrack traps, zoned transport and mid-circuit readout, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照Willow 非諧能階與Yb離子與集體模態，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Quantinuum H2 QCCD 離子架構，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以跨碼距閾值比較為起點，設計一項能區分「碼距、每循環邏輯錯誤與完整系統指標」與「跑道陷阱、分區搬運及中途量測」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare willow anharmonic levels with yb ions and collective modes and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Quantinuum H2 QCCD ion architecture, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from cross-distance threshold comparison and propose an observation distinguishing code distance, logical error per cycle and system metrics from racetrack traps, zoned transport and mid-circuit readout, including uncertainty.

history.textEn: Public sources for Google Willow surface-code system illustrate code distance, logical error per cycle and system metrics. The course reconstructs functional layers and verifiable outputs educationally without proprietary manufacturing access.
